_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Checking Golf Club Index sold prices...

description: Use when someone asks what a used golf club is worth, sells for, or should cost, including sellers asking "what's my X worth" or "what should I list it for". Takes a club as the person said it (brand and model, e.g. "TaylorMade P790 irons", "Vokey SM9 56", "sim2 max driver"). Returns the fair used price range (25th percentile to median of completed eBay sales), the average sale, the number of sales, the 30-day trend, live asking prices where available, the data date, and a link to the club's page on golfclubindex.com. When no club matches confidently it returns the nearest tracked clubs by name. Prices are not split by condition.

condition.description: The club's condition if the user gave one (e.g. 'good', 'like new'). Optional; prices are not split by condition.

query.description: The club as the user said it, e.g. 'taylormade p790 irons' or 'what's my vokey sm9 56 worth'

name: golf_used_value
title: Used golf club value
